what: The site's own copies of the bytes the machine document needs. Each hash here was recorded from the chain when the copy was made; the same hashes are pinned in code (machine/src/core.html for the emulator, machine/bridge-client.js for the emulator and the firmware), and the build and the site check hold the files, this record and those pins to one another offline. Re-checking this record against Ethereum is the standalone document's boot and the public verifier's job. The machine page reads the chain first and uses these when no node answers.
